title: SPOT settings (data model v2)
description: What an admin changes at an event, one document per tenant (ADR 0003, DV-13). Secrets are environment variables, never stored here.

_id.description: The tenant id: one settings document per tenant.

activeEventId.description: The event being scouted (DV-12a). Shown and chosen by its code, never this id (DV-12b).

startRules.description: When waiting scouters enter a match without an admin starting it (RT-12a, ADR 0006).

quorum.description: Connected waiting scouters on the current match that start it. Default 6.

startOnFirstScouter.description: One scouter starting pulls in everyone waiting (issue 34). Default off.

fieldFlipped.description: The field orientation (A-19, SC-28): true swaps the alliance-relative buttons' places and turns the field map, for when the blue alliance is on the scouters' left.
